# PUT /api/v1/orgs/{org}/actions/variables/{variablename}

Update an org-level variable

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-047`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| variablename | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `UpdateVariableOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `name` | string | False | if provided, must match naming rules |
| `value` | string | True | max 65536 runes |
| `description` | string | False | truncated to 4096 runes |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **400** — Invalid variable name or data too long
- **404** — Variable or organization not found
- **403** — User is not org owner or site admin

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Organization ownership required for all actions endpoints (secrets, variables, runners) | authorization | User is not org owner AND not site admin |
| Variable names must match pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$ (case insensitive), cannot start with GITEA_/GITHUB_, cannot be 'CI' | validation | Name doesn't match pattern OR has forbidden prefix OR equals CI |
| Variable data cannot exceed 65536 runes | validation | utf8.RuneCountInString(data) > VariableDataMaxLength |
| Variable description is truncated to 4096 runes (not rejected) | validation | Description exceeds 4096 runes |
| Variable names are stored uppercased | business_logic | Always on insert/update |
| Variable data has EOL normalized before storage | business_logic | Always on create/update |
| UpdateVariable uses path param name as default if body name is empty | business_logic | opt.Name == "" |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Variable not found by name | 404 | notFound | False |
| Invalid new name or data too long | 400 | error | False |

### Error Paths

- **Org not found** → orgAssignment → 404
- **Variable not found** → Action.UpdateVariable → 404
- **Invalid new name** → UpdateVariableNameData → 400
- **Data too long** → UpdateVariableCols → 400
